conditional_proofs.claim: For valid complete episodes starting with equal Q/P/X, empty D, identical Q* and matching Xi coordinates, original and v90 DQ choose identical commands, produce identical traces and finish with exact equal effective-Q contents.
steps: Both nonexploration branches call snapshot.q_decision_provider on the same numeric state. Exploration uses the same is_explore/uniform_action helpers and ascending full admissible set.
Step index is one command per actual step in both providers. The kernel receives the same frozen P/X, proposal, tape and kappa, hence the same complete trace.
Both call the identical original sweep_edits: true START/pre-state/in-force/a_cmd, chronological working-effective-Q, max admissible bootstrap, reward-only terminal, binary64 arithmetic.
Same final effective edits canonicalize through the same original transaction. Clone/publication identities differ but stored numeric contents agree.
Induct over any finite sequence of properly ordered matching episodes. DQ evaluation uses the same greedy operator; summing identical returns in original scene order gives identical ordered means.
limitations: Current public exact-type check rejects original ExogenousEpisode; coordinate matching here is a mathematical premise, not a implemented formal connector.
Not a native full-grid differential run or transferred F1 PASS. Not equivalence of error traces, empty transaction call counts, object identity or all possible invalid inputs.

conditional_proofs.claim: Where D stays empty and L is mapped to original Q, patch reads/TD reduce to the original numeric path for the same valid episodes and P/X; no D is inserted by policy improvement.
limitations: Actual patch constructor starts L empty. A nonempty C3-to-L initializer is not implemented or authorized by this proof.
Do not insert C3 into production patch L0, turn a hypothetical mapped initial state into an issued object, or infer nonempty-D baseline equivalence.

conditional_proofs.consequence: Requires explicit revision and new qualification, not a wrapper fix or old F1 migration.
